Gross $44,000.00 less 5% retention $2,200.00 less previous $14,250.00 = $27,550.00. The amount due is lower than gross because of retention (clause 3.1); this is correct.

findings.says: Doors are excluded from the contract. CO-004 ($2,500.00) is not signed by the client; INV-010 bills $8,500.00, $6,000.00 more than the unsigned CO. REC-2026-10-12 is a request and estimate only (client asks for the CO first). SR-2026-10-15 cites a 13 Oct approval email that is not in the archive. DN-5531 and the 9 Oct diary show the doors were delivered on 2026-10-09, three days before the recorded request. IMG_3377 (2026-10-10) shows empty openings, IMG_3412 (2026-10-15) doors. Gamma CO-004 and Beta CO-004/INV-010 belong to other projects and are not evidence. Action: verify amount and locate approval before accepting.

Invoice cites Rev A ($5,200.00, 40 m2, signed 2026-07-08); Rev B ($6,100.00, 48 m2) signed later on 2026-07-15; REC-2026-07-14 has the client rep recalling approval on 9 July and saying no new amount is agreed; SR-2026-07-20 reports 48 m2 placed. Do not choose a version or amount; mark for review.
Possible duplicate: same CO-001 reference, 100 m and $3,000.00 as INV-001; different number, date and wording. $3,000.00 possibly billed twice.

findings.says: Design-coordination change (RFI-017, M-201 Rev C). CO-005 $1,800.00 not signed by client; verbal go-ahead 'up to $1,800' in REC-2026-09-22; work reported done in SR-2026-09-28. Not invoiced yet: risk of future billing without signed CO.
Referenced in SR-2026-10-15 but not in the archive (09-Correspondence has no such email). Do not claim it exists or what it says.
No EXIF date, no GPS, no date in the name; cannot be tied to any record.

Design omission (RFI-014, A-102 Rev C). Approval evidence exists only in an email: client rep approved $2,600.00 on 2026-08-06 under clause 4.5. Clause 4.5 requires a formal Change Order within 14 days; CO-009 is referenced but no CO-009 was found in the accessible project records. Amount matches the email (40 m2 x $65).

Unforeseen condition (asbestos; hazardous-material removal excluded from contract). Amount matches signed CO-008 ($4,400.00, signed 2026-09-10). Date problem: condition first recorded 2026-08-18, written notice 2026-09-04 (17 days; clause 4.6 says 7 days); removal started 2026-08-24, before CO-008 was signed (clause 4.1). INV-008 is an image-only scan: if the run cannot read it, the correct output for the invoice itself is Insufficient data (unreadable), never a guessed amount.

findings.says: PA-03 claims 230 m2 against a contract quantity of 200 m2: 30 m2 x $60 = $1,800.00 gross over the contract with no change order. The extra walls were a verbal request (REC-2026-08-12, diary 12/08). The 250 m2 in from-tender/Scope-Schedule_rev0.pdf is superseded and does not support the claim. PC-03 did not withhold this amount.

Signed deduction CO-007 (2026-08-03) omits 150 m2; PA-03 still claims 300 m2 ($7,500.00) instead of 150 m2 ($3,750.00): $3,750.00 gross over-claim. DN-4702 (158 m2, Level 1 only) and SR-2026-08-28 agree. PC-03 already withheld it.
PA-03 received 2026-10-02; PC-03 issued 2026-10-28 (26 days; clause 3.3 says 14). Email thread shows the contractor chasing on 21 Oct. Report the dates only; no conclusion about breach.
About 2.5 s of noisy, low-level speech with no project, item, amount or date. Must not be used to support or refute anything.
Stored in the Alpha folder and dated 2026-10-15, but its GPS is about 5 km from the Alpha site reference point and next to the Gamma site reference point. Cannot corroborate Alpha's doors.
